arguments.query:
WITH fraud AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS tx_id, card_scheme, eur_amount,
         CAST(issuing_country = acquirer_country AS INT64) AS intra
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Rafa_AI' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 274 AND 304 AND has_fraudulent_dispute = TRUE
),
cand AS (SELECT aci FROM UNNEST(['A','B','C','D','E','F']) AS aci),
matched AS (
  SELECT f.tx_id, f.card_scheme, c.aci, fe.ID, f.eur_amount, fe.fixed_amount, fe.rate
  FROM fraud f
  CROSS JOIN cand c
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` fe ON fe.card_scheme = f.card_scheme
  WHERE (ARRAY_LENGTH(fe.account_type) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(fe.account_type))
    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(fe.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR 7372 IN UNNEST(fe.merchant_category_code))
    AND (fe.capture_delay IS NULL OR fe.capture_delay = '>5')
    AND (fe.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR fe.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
    AND (fe.monthly_volume IS NULL OR fe.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
    AND (fe.is_credit IS NULL OR fe.is_credit = TRUE)
    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(fe.aci) = 0 OR c.aci IN UNNEST(fe.aci))
    AND (fe.intracountry IS NULL OR fe.intracountry = f.intra)
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT tx_id, card_scheme, aci, COUNT(*) AS n_match, MIN(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_min, MAX(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_max
  FROM matched GROUP BY tx_id, card_scheme, aci
)
SELECT card_scheme, aci, COUNT(*) AS tx_matched, SUM(n_match) AS total_rule_matches, ROUND(SUM(fee_min), 2) AS total_fee_min, ROUND(SUM(fee_max), 2) AS total_fee_max
FROM per_tx
GROUP BY card_scheme, aci
ORDER BY aci, card_scheme

WITH fraud AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS txn_id, card_scheme, eur_amount, (issuing_country = acquirer_country) AS is_domestic
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Rafa_AI' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 274 AND 304
    AND has_fraudulent_dispute = TRUE AND is_credit = TRUE
),
cand AS (SELECT aci FROM UNNEST(['A','B','C','D','E','F']) AS aci),
matched AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, t.card_scheme, c.aci, t.eur_amount,
    f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM fraud t
  CROSS JOIN cand c
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme
   AND f.is_credit = TRUE
   AND (IFNULL(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci),0) = 0 OR c.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (IFNULL(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type),0) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (IFNULL(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code),0) = 0 OR 7372 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '>5')
   AND f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL
   AND f.monthly_volume IS NULL
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = CAST(t.is_domestic AS INT64))
),
per_txn AS (
  SELECT card_scheme, aci, txn_id, MIN(fee) AS min_fee, MAX(fee) AS max_fee, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, ANY_VALUE(eur_amount) AS eur_amount
  FROM matched GROUP BY card_scheme, aci, txn_id
)
SELECT card_scheme, aci,
  COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) AS n_fraud_txn_matched,
  ROUND(SUM(min_fee), 2) AS total_fee_min_rule,
  ROUND(SUM(max_fee), 2) AS total_fee_max_rule,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_rules > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS txns_with_multiple_rules
FROM per_txn GROUP BY card_scheme, aci ORDER BY card_scheme, total_fee_min_rule

WITH fraud AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit,
    CASE WHEN p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intracountry,
    p.eur_amount
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Rafa_AI' AND p.year = 2023 AND p.day_of_year BETWEEN 274 AND 304
    AND p.has_fraudulent_dispute = TRUE
),
cand AS (SELECT aci FROM UNNEST(['A','B','C','D','E','F','G']) AS aci),
matched AS (
  SELECT f.psp_reference, f.card_scheme, c.aci AS candidate_aci, r.ID, (r.fixed_amount + r.rate * f.eur_amount / 10000) AS fee
  FROM fraud f
  CROSS JOIN cand c
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` r
    ON r.card_scheme = f.card_scheme
   AND (r.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(r.account_type) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(r.account_type))
   AND (r.capture_delay IS NULL OR r.capture_delay = '>5')
   AND (r.monthly_volume IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
   AND (r.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR r.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
   AND (r.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(r.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR 7372 IN UNNEST(r.merchant_category_code))
   AND (r.is_credit IS NULL OR r.is_credit = f.is_credit)
   AND (r.intracountry IS NULL OR r.intracountry = f.intracountry)
   AND (r.aci IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(r.aci) = 0 OR c.aci IN UNNEST(r.aci))
)
SELECT candidate_aci, card_scheme, COUNT(DISTINCT psp_reference) AS txns,
  COUNT(*) AS matching_rules, ROUND(SUM(fee),2) AS total_fee, ROUND(AVG(fee),4) AS avg_fee
FROM matched
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY candidate_aci, total_fee

arguments.query:
WITH fraud_txns AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.eur_amount,
    CASE WHEN p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intracountry
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Rafa_AI' AND p.year = 2023 AND p.day_of_year BETWEEN 274 AND 304 AND p.has_fraudulent_dispute = TRUE
),
cand AS (SELECT aci FROM UNNEST(['A','B','C','D','E','F','G']) AS aci),
matched AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.card_scheme, c.aci, f.ID, f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM fraud_txns t
  CROSS JOIN cand c
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = t.intracountry)
   AND (f.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (f.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR 7372 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '>5')
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
   AND (f.aci IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci) = 0 OR c.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
)
SELECT card_scheme, aci, COUNT(DISTINCT psp_reference) AS txns, COUNT(*) AS matched_rules,
  ROUND(SUM(fee), 2) AS total_fee_if_moved, ROUND(AVG(fee), 4) AS avg_fee
FROM (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, aci, MIN(fee) AS fee, COUNT(*) AS n_rules_matched_per_txn
  FROM matched GROUP BY psp_reference, card_scheme, aci
)
JOIN UNNEST([1]) ON TRUE
GROUP BY card_scheme, aci
ORDER BY card_scheme, avg_fee

  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Rafa_AI' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 274 AND 304 AND has_fraudulent_dispute
),
cand AS (SELECT aci FROM UNNEST(['A','B','C','D','E','F']) AS aci),
rules AS (
  SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
  WHERE (monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')

    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(COALESCE(account_type, [])) = 0 OR 'D' IN UNNEST(account_type))
    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(COALESCE(merchant_category_code, [])) = 0 OR 7372 IN UNNEST(merchant_category_code))
),
m AS (
  SELECT f.psp_reference, f.card_scheme, c.aci AS cand_aci, r.ID AS rule_id,
         r.fixed_amount + r.rate * f.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM fraud f
  CROSS JOIN cand c
  JOIN rules r
    ON r.card_scheme = f.card_scheme
   AND (r.is_credit IS NULL OR r.is_credit = f.is_credit)

  COUNT(*) AS rule_matches,
  ROUND(SUM(fee), 2) AS total_fee_all_matches,
  ROUND(MIN(fee), 4) AS min_rule_fee,
  ROUND(MAX(fee), 4) AS max_rule_fee
FROM m

arguments.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT merchant, capture_delay, merchant_category_code, account_type
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_data` WHERE merchant = 'Rafa_AI'
),
t AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.eur_amount, p.issuing_country, p.acquirer_country, p.has_fraudulent_dispute
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  JOIN m ON p.merchant = m.merchant
  WHERE p.year = 2023 AND p.day_of_year BETWEEN 274 AND 304
),
vol AS (
  SELECT SUM(eur_amount) AS total_vol,
         SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) * 100 AS fraud_pct
  FROM t
),
bands AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN total_vol < 100000 THEN '<100k'
         WHEN total_vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN total_vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_band,
    CASE WHEN fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%'
         WHEN fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_band
  FROM vol
),
ft AS (
  SELECT t.*, m.account_type, m.merchant_category_code,
    CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(m.capture_delay AS INT64) > 5 THEN '>5'
         WHEN SAFE_CAST(m.capture_delay AS INT64) >= 3 THEN '3-5'
         WHEN SAFE_CAST(m.capture_delay AS INT64) < 3 THEN '<3' ELSE m.capture_delay END AS capture_delay,
    b.vol_band, b.fraud_band, (t.issuing_country = t.acquirer_country) AS is_intra
  FROM t CROSS JOIN m CROSS JOIN bands b
  WHERE t.has_fraudulent_dispute
),
aci_list AS (SELECT aci FROM UNNEST(['A','B','C','D','E','F','G']) AS aci),
priced AS (
  SELECT ft.psp_reference, a.aci, r.ID AS rule_id,
         r.fixed_amount + r.rate * ft.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM ft
  CROSS JOIN aci_list a
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` r
    ON (r.card_scheme = ft.card_scheme OR r.card_scheme IS NULL)
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(r.account_type) = 0 OR ft.account_type IN UNNEST(r.account_type))
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(r.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR ft.merchant_category_code IN UNNEST(r.merchant_category_code))
   AND (r.is_credit IS NULL OR r.is_credit = ft.is_credit)
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(r.aci) = 0 OR a.aci IN UNNEST(r.aci))
   AND (r.intracountry IS NULL OR r.intracountry = IF(ft.is_intra, 1, 0))
   AND (r.capture_delay IS NULL OR r.capture_delay = ft.capture_delay)
   AND (r.monthly_volume IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume = ft.vol_band)
   AND (r.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR r.monthly_fraud_level = ft.fraud_band)
)
SELECT aci,
  COUNT(DISTINCT psp_reference) AS fraud_txns_priced,
  COUNT(*) AS matched_rule_rows,
  ROUND(SUM(fee), 2) AS total_fee_eur
FROM priced
GROUP BY aci
ORDER BY total_fee_eur
